mapper.sql: t.id, t.sku_id AS skuId, k.sku_code AS skuCode, p.name AS productName, k.spec_name AS skuName, k.sale_unit AS saleUnit, t.unit_price AS unitPrice, t.start_at AS startAt, t.end_at AS endAt, t.remark, t.version, t.created_by AS createdBy, t.created_at AS createdAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM xsy_pricing_time_price t LEFT JOIN xsy_product_sku k ON k.id = t.sku_id LEFT JOIN xsy_product_spu p ON p.id = k.spu_id WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.deleted = FALSE

SELECT id, sku_id, unit_price, start_at, end_at, version, deleted FROM xsy_pricing_time_price WHERE deleted = FALSE AND start_at <= #{at} AND end_at > #{at} AND sku_id IN #{sku} ORDER BY start_at DESC, id DESC
